method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Built overlay is a centred ~600 px dialog; the reference is a 1000 px sheet.
Matches / Explain / Replace / Export / Cheat sheet tabs are absent.
ECMAScript / QRegularExpression / Both segmented control absent; built states a single engine.
Guided token chips exist but the reference's token-block editor with drag-to-reorder is absent.
Sample text and match/capture list present.

defects.summary: Builder lacks the reference workbench: tabs, dialect switch, pattern library, token blocks, explain/replace/export
